title: Immunization Services Reduction Ceiling Chart
content:
# Immunization Services — Reduction Ceiling on Cash Dose Charges

**Ceiling.** The reductions on the charge for a cash-paid Immunization Services dose are capped: at **22 percent** where a membership fee was charged in the last 12 calendar months and the pharmacy-patient reduction applies, at **18 percent** where a membership fee was charged in that time and it does not, and at **100 percent** otherwise.

## Chart

| Membership fee charged in the last 12 calendar months | Pharmacy-patient reduction on the charge | Ceiling on the reductions |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Applies (above zero) | 22 percent |
| Yes | Does not apply (zero) | 18 percent |
| No | Applies or not | 100 percent |

## Reading the chart

- **Membership fee charged** means a membership fee charge entry in the patient's programme activity under **Savings & Copay Assistance Programs**, on any of the patient's savings programme enrollments.
- **In the last 12 calendar months** means dated fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today; a whole calendar month has passed once the same day of the month is reached again. A fee dated exactly 12 whole months before today is outside the window.
- **The pharmacy-patient reduction applies** when it is above zero on the charge being settled.
- A ceiling of 100 percent places no practical limit below the full price.

## Examples (hypothetical inputs)

1. A membership fee charged 5 months ago; a pharmacy-patient reduction of a hypothetical 3 percent stands on the charge. Ceiling **22 percent**.
2. A membership fee charged 5 months ago; no pharmacy-patient reduction. Ceiling **18 percent**.
3. The last membership fee was charged 13 months ago. Ceiling **100 percent**, whether or not a pharmacy-patient reduction stands.
4. No membership fee has ever been charged. Ceiling **100 percent**.
